title: Pacta RPC-pinned control-plane records
description: Read-only control-plane observations of 158 protocols (146 Ethereum, 12 Base), each pinned to a canonical block number and block hash and reproducible with cast. These records are NOT EAS-attested: they have no sprint number, no summary document and no Base EAS UID. The Base-EAS-attested Sprint records are in /api/v1/index.json. Euler V2 (EVK) and Moonwell Lending (Base) were re-scanned in Sprint 18, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Pendle Finance V2 and Rocket Pool (rETH) were re-scanned in Sprint 19, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Frax Ether (frxETH / sfrxETH) and Puffer Finance (pufETH) were re-scanned in Sprint 20, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Aerodrome Finance (Base) and Balancer V2 Vault & TimelockAuthorizer were re-scanned in Sprint 21, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Across Protocol (HubPool) and Beefy Finance (Base) were re-scanned in Sprint 22, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Uniswap V3 & Governance Timelock and Reserve Protocol (eUSD RToken) were re-scanned in Sprint 23, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Synthetix V3 Core and Centrifuge V3 Root (Base) were re-scanned in Sprint 24, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Bedrock (uniETH) and Safe Smart Account (v1.4.1 Singleton) were re-scanned in Sprint 25, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Sprint 26 published 44 further protocols here (bulk harvester v1.3 promotion, documentation not compared) and moved every record to the Sprint 26 pinned heads, each stated fact re-read unchanged. Sprint 27 published 82 further protocols here (bulk harvester v1.3 promotion, documentation not compared) and moved every record to the Sprint 27 pinned heads, each stated fact re-read unchanged. Sprint 28 published 69 further protocols here (bulk harvester v2.0 promotion, documentation not compared), converted 3 to Base-EAS records (strata-markets, vesper-v1, zircuit-staking) and moved every other record to the Sprint 28 pinned heads, each stated fact re-read (a controller Safe quorum changed: world-chain-bridge 3-of-8 -> 3-of-6). Sprint 29 published 0 further protocols here (bulk harvester v2.0 promotion, documentation not compared), converted 1 to Base-EAS records (flaunch) and moved every other record to the Sprint 29 pinned heads, each stated fact re-read. Sprint 30 published 0 further protocols here (bulk harvester v2.0 promotion, documentation not compared), converted 15 to Base-EAS records (abracadabra-spell, arrakis-modular, exactly, flying-tulip-lend, goldfinch, iaero-protocol, jpy-defi, kpk, makina, meta-pool-eth, nuva, panoptic-v2, shift-defi, spectra-metavaults, vetro) and moved every other record to the Sprint 30 pinned heads, each stated fact re-read. Sprint 31 published 0 further protocols here (bulk harvester v2.0 promotion, documentation not compared), converted 10 to Base-EAS records (alchemix-v3, bancor-v3, cian-yield-layer, decentralized-euro, dolomite, idle, noon, origin-superoeth-base, sonic-gateway, trueo) and moved every other record to the Sprint 31 pinned heads, each stated fact re-read. Sprint 32 published 0 further protocols here (bulk harvester v2.0 promotion, documentation not compared), converted 12 to Base-EAS records (benddao-ape-staking, bio-protocol, dydx-v3, ekubo, hashport, inceptionlrt-isolated-restaking, lista-lending, metric-v1, morpheusai, pickle, superform-v2-base, tori-finance) and moved every other record to the Sprint 32 pinned heads, each stated fact re-read.

attestation.note: No on-chain attestation exists for these records yet; any future attestation will be added here with its UID.

verification: Captured by one Pacta seat over public JSON-RPC and independently re-read at the same pinned blocks by a second seat (block hash, runtime bytecode size and keccak256, EIP-1967 implementation / admin slots, controller getter, Safe getThreshold / getOwners, timelock delay). Two records were corrected by the re-read (Moonwell admin contract, Uniswap V3 factory owner contract).
